name: TeaCache (timestep-embedding-aware cache)
plain: Skips the DiT block stack when the first block's modulated input has hardly changed since the last computed step, and re-adds the stored residual instead. The raw relative change is mapped through a per-model polynomial, then accumulated until it crosses the threshold. Polynomial coefficients are per architecture and per Wan variant, so the model_type must match.
math:
δ = mean|m_t − m_prev| / mean|m_prev|, m = first-block modulated input (Flux: img_norm1·(1+scale)+shift; Wan: e, or e0 with _ret_mode; HiDream full: timesteps, else hidden_states)
A += |poly(δ)|, poly = 4th-degree per-model coefficient list
If A < rel_l1_thresh: skip stack; x += R
Else A=0; run stack; R = x_out − x_in
CFG models keep separate state for cond and uncond, but a batch runs if either wants to; Flux/HunyuanVideo keep one state.
start/end_percent by step index in sample_sigmas.
